description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - laundry watch: an attention-outsourcing washing-machine watcher - face the panel and register the minutes it shows, bound to a head heading; the countdown runs while you leave the balcony, a soft call comes three minutes before your estimate ends, and at zero it calls you back by direction until you face the machine again (or tap ACK); an optional omnidirectional level watch nudges you once per episode if a short loud sound spikes during the last stretch - loudness level only, never beep recognition; timers live only while the agent is open and nothing is stored
name: laundry-watch
